title: Number Guessing Game Deluxe
story: The guessing game from L7, evolved. Difficulty levels that change the range and max attempts. Hints: too high, too low, 'you're within 5', 'the number is prime'. Score tracking, play-again loop, and a best-score leaderboard. This is the version you'd proudly show a friend.
why: This deluxe version synthesizes enums for difficulty, structs for game state, contracts for validation, loops, conditionals, and Vec for leaderboards — a complete polished application.
analogy: A carnival 'Guess the Jellybeans' game with three jar sizes. Easy jar: 50 beans, 10 guesses. Hard jar: 200 beans, only 5 guesses. Hints cost a guess but narrow the range. Your high score gets posted on the carnival leaderboard for everyone to see.
try_it: Add a 'custom' difficulty where the player chooses the range and max attempts. Add an achievement system: 'First Win', 'Speed Demon' (win in 3 or fewer), 'Hard Mode Master'. Track average attempts per difficulty across all games.
tips: Difficulty enums map cleanly to configuration tuples (range, attempts)
Hints should cost something — hint_used counter reduces final score
Leaderboard capped at top N — auto-sort and truncate on each score insertion
common_mistakes: Not resetting game state on 'play again' — stale secret, attempts, etc.
Giving hints that reveal the answer too easily — e.g., 'within 2' on a hard round
Leaderboard growing unbounded — cap at 5 or 10 entries
